# Repository Instructions

This repository packages the `design-taste` Codex skill.

## Editing the Skill

- Keep `skills/design-taste/SKILL.md` focused on core behavior and routing.
- Put detailed guidance in `skills/design-taste/references/` and link it from `SKILL.md`.
- Do not load or duplicate every reference into `SKILL.md`.
- Preserve YAML frontmatter with `name` and `description`.
- Keep `skills/design-taste/agents/openai.yaml` aligned with the skill name and purpose.

## Repository Style

- Prefer concise documentation over large auxiliary guides.
- Keep examples practical and prompt-oriented.
- Avoid generated marketing claims that the skill does not support.
- Use ASCII text unless a file already requires otherwise.
